title: "Module 06 — Run It Locally"
description: "Verify that a local MiniKube cluster can host the full Make the Lamp Nod runtime."

## Goal

Reuse the [Kubernetes course](../../kubernetes/) for the canonical MiniKube
home. This module does not re-teach MiniKube install, Pod creation, or
Deployment management. The learner must already know Pods, Deployments,
Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, namespaces, controllers, and reconciliation.

## Local architecture

MiniKube hosts the complete runtime on one developer workstation:

```
Developer Workstation
+-----------------------------------------------+
| MiniKube                                      |
|                                               |
| Crossplane                                    |
| Open Engineering resources                    |
| Manifold                                      |
| Pico runtime                                  |
| event/messaging infrastructure                |
| Home Assistant integration                    |
| observability                                 |
+-----------------------------------------------+
                       |
                       | LAN / Wi-Fi
                       v
                    ESP32
                       |
                       v
                   74HCT245
                       |
                       v
                    AX-12A
                       |
                       v
                     Lamp
```

See [MiniKube](../../kubernetes/) for installation, profiles, and cluster
management. Everything inside the dashed box runs in MiniKube; the ESP32
connects over the local network.

## Validation commands

These commands verify that the prerequisites for this course are present. They
do not install anything -- they confirm what the [Kubernetes course](../../kubernetes/)
already set up.

### Kubernetes cluster

```bash
kubectl cluster-info
```

Expected: the control plane URL is reported and the cluster is reachable.

```bash
kubectl get nodes
```

Expected: at least one node in `Ready` state.

### Crossplane

```bash
kubectl get pods -n crossplane-system
```

Expected: the Crossplane pod is `Running`.

```bash
kubectl get provider
```

Expected: the Kubernetes Provider is `Installed` and `Healthy`.

### Pico CLI

```bash
which pico
pico --version
```

Expected: the `pico` binary resolves on `PATH` and reports a version.

::: {.callout-tip}
If any of these checks fail, return to the prerequisite course for the
relevant technology and resolve it before continuing. The
[Kubernetes course](../../kubernetes/) is the canonical source for cluster
setup; the [Crossplane course](../../crossplane/) covers Crossplane
installation.
:::

## Exercise

Run every validation command above and confirm the expected output. If any
command fails, identify which prerequisite course covers the fix and complete
that step before proceeding to Module 07.
